items.title: WESTERN ASTROLOGY
items.line: The zodiac starts at the spring equinox,|so the signs follow the seasons.

items.title: VEDIC ASTROLOGY
items.line: The zodiac is fixed to the stars.|It sits about 24° behind the Western one.

items.title: THE AYANAMSA
items.line: That gap is the ayanamsa. It is why many|Western Scorpios are Vedic Libras.

items.title: WITHIN READS BOTH
items.line: Western shows psychology and timing.|Vedic adds the Moon star and life periods.

caption:
Why your Vedic sign is different from your Western sign. ✦

Western astrology (tropical) starts the zodiac at the spring equinox. Vedic astrology (sidereal) fixes it to the stars, about 24° behind. That gap is the ayanamsa.

Send this to the friend who says 'but I'm a different sign in Vedic'.

#vedicastrology #westernastrology #astrology101 #jyotish #zodiac

items.title: THE EASTERN HORIZON
items.line: Your rising sign is the sign on the|eastern horizon at your birth minute.

items.title: IT SETS YOUR HOUSES
items.line: The 1st house begins at your rising sign.|The other houses follow in order.

items.title: WHY BIRTH TIME MATTERS
items.line: A new sign rises about every two hours,|so a few minutes can change it.

items.title: HOW TO READ THEM
items.line: Sun: who you are. Moon: what you need.|Rising: how you meet the world.

caption:
How to read your rising sign, in 20 seconds. ✦

It is the sign on the eastern horizon at your birth minute, and it sets your houses. A new sign rises about every two hours, so birth time matters.

items.title: THE NAKSHATRAS
items.line: Vedic astrology splits the zodiac|into 27 lunar stars, 13°20' each.

items.title: WHICH ONE IS YOURS
items.line: The star your Moon was in at birth|shapes temperament and life periods.

items.title: THREE OF THE 27
items.line: Ashwini, the healer. Rohini, the growing|one. Magha, the throne.

items.title: THE TIMING
items.line: Your Moon star sets your dasha:|the order of your life chapters.

caption:
What is a nakshatra? The Vedic star sign almost nobody knows. ✦

There are 27 lunar stars, each 13°20' wide. The one your Moon was in at birth shapes your temperament and your dasha, the order of your life chapters.

items.title: THE PAUSE
items.line: A planet seems to stand still|against the stars, then reverse.

items.title: WHY IT HAPPENS
items.line: Planets overtake each other in orbit,|so one seems to slide backward.

items.title: THE RHYTHM
items.line: Mercury 3 or 4 times a year, Venus about|every 19 months, Saturn every year.

items.title: WEST AND EAST
items.line: Western: a time to review and revisit.|Vedic: vakri, a planet gaining strength.

caption:
What is a retrograde station? ☿

A station is when a planet seems to stand still against the stars before it reverses. It is a trick of perspective, as planets overtake each other. Western astrology reads review and revisiting; Vedic astrology calls it vakri and reads strength.
